title: Fastest browser engine by far at 500 FPS! Servo Webrender - CSS on the GPU part 1: Rust
summary: An excerpt from a Bay Area Rust meetup on Servo's WebRender, which renders CSS display lists on the GPU at very high frame rates. It explains the approach and demos rendering at around 500 FPS.
why: HN commenters point to it when discussing how WebRender works and as evidence of what GPU-based browser rendering can achieve.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: If you have the time there is a nice talk about WebRender
